name: Komodo Island
about: Dry season Apr–Dec has calmer seas and better visibility, wet season Jan–Mar brings rain and rougher crossings.
overview: Komodo dragons plus superb diving — prehistoric-looking lizards on land, manta rays and pink-sand beaches in the water.
costOverview: Komodo has one of the widest price ranges in this list — a shared budget liveaboard runs a couple hundred dollars total, while the luxury liveaboards charge that much per night.
monthlyWeather: hot and wet, the wettest month with rough seas and reduced visibility
